description: Added an opt-in read/write (socket) inactivity timeout for the CRT-based HTTP clients (`AwsCrtHttpClient` and `AwsCrtAsyncHttpClient`). It is not enabled unless you set the `AWS_ENABLE_DEFAULT_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_2026` environment variable or the `aws.enableDefaultSocketTimeout2026` system property. Once enabled, an SDK-managed CRT HTTP client that has no explicit `connectionHealthConfiguration` set receives a per-service read/write timeout; a connection that makes no read or write progress within that window is closed and the in-flight request fails with a retryable `IOException`. The timeout is not applied to an HTTP client you build and supply yourself via `httpClient(...)`.
